rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar (AMs) na Welsh suna damuwa da "kama kamar muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu AMs da shawarar canza taken su zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: An samo shi ne saboda shirin canza sunan majalisar zuwa majalisar Welsh.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a ko'ina cikininin da'irar siyasa suna damuwa cewa zai iya jawo dariya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "jam'iyyar tana damuwa cewa yana da kama da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft kuma pwp yana nufin poo.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani Plaid AM ya ce kungiyar gaba ɗaya "ba ta yi farin ciki ba" kuma ta ba da shawarar wasu madadin.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani ɗan jam'iyyar Conservative na Welsh ya ce kungiyar sa tana da "hankali" game da canza sunan, amma ya lura cewa yana da gajeren tafiya daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana magana da shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u a Yorkshire English.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana rubuta dokar da za ta gabatar da gyare-gyaren suna, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani bayani game da abin da ake kira 'Yan Majalisar za ta kasance a hannun 'yan majalisar da kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba da ikon canza sunan majalisar Welsh.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani tattaunawa da jama'a kan shawarar da aka yi, wanda ya nuna goyon baya mai faɗi na kiran majalisar da Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: Akan batun sunan AMs, Hukumar ta goyi bayan mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya samu mafi yawan goyon baya a cikin wani bincike na jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: AMs suna bayyana wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma ƙalubalen da ke cikin cimma yarjejeniya na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran za ta gabatar da kundin dokar da aka gabatar kan gyare-gyaren cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar sauye-sauyen za ta hada da wasu gyare-gyare kan yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka'idoji kan cire 'yan majalisar da kuma tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: AMs za su samu kuri'a ta karshe kan abin da za su kira lokacin da suka yi muhawara kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedoniyawa suna tafiya da zaɓe a cikin zaɓen canza suna ƙasar.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu kada kuri'a za su yi zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar su zuwa "Jamhuriyar Arewa ta Makka."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri’ar jama’a ne a matsayin wani yunƙuri na warware takaddamar da ta dade da makwabciyar kasar Girka, wadda ke da yanki mai suna Masedoniya.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi imanin cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirarin mallakar ƙasa, kuma ta ci gaba da adawa da bukatarta ta shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban Masedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ke adawa da plebiscite kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da kuri'ar.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben suna jayayya cewa suna ganin suna da muhimmanci don shiga Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: An yi shiru a cikin Agogon St.
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane lungu," Mista Adams ya ce.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "Yau, babu."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya tana da ma'ana.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Mutane suna mu'amala da juna ta hanyar daban" yanzu, in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An yi watsi da mashaya a matsayin dakunan zama na unguwanni inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewaudin kudi daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dade kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammanin zai yi ba, "kuma da wuri ko wuri za su dawo inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Cocin, ya kara da cewa, za a iya maye gurbinsa da gine-gine na gidan zama da gidajen da za su cika da mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran masu tsarkake yankin ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawancin mutanen da ke sayen gidajen gidan haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance 'yan Caucasian," in ji shi, "sannan za su hanzarta rufewa na waɗannan majami'u gaba daya domin ba zai yiwu ba cewa mafi yawan wadannan mutane da suka koma wannan gidanaya za su zama mambobin waɗannan majami'u."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan cocin biyu an gina su ne da al'ummomin fari kafin Harlem ta zama birni mai rinjaye baƙar fata - Cocin Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: An yi watsi da cocin Methodist na farko a shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Wani cocin baƙar fata da ya yi ibada kusa da shi ya karɓi ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An dauki St. Martin a karkashin jagorancin wani cocin baƙar fata a karkashin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin cin abinci a kan titin 125, babban titin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya yi adawa da daukar ma'aikata ko kuma inganta baƙar fata.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wani wuta a shekarar 1939 ya bar ginin da munanan lalacewa, amma yayin da Father Johnson's parishioners ke shirya sake gina shi, sun ba da umarni na carillon.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Mai bishara Dauda Yohanna, ɗan Mai bishara Yohanna da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da cewa "carrilong" "agogo masu talauci."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararren wanda ya buga carillon a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu daban: "Wani kadara al'adu" da kuma "wani kayan tarihi mara maye gurbinsa."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Kwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta kuma lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da aka yi wa 'yan asalin Afirka, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin bai maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: Abin da ya faru a St. Martin a cikin watanni da suka gabata ya kasance wani labari mai rikitarwa na masu gine-gine da masu aikin gine-gine, wasu da masu kula da cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma da bishop din cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Majalisar limamin - majalisar da ke gudanar da al'umma, wanda ya ƙunshi shugabanni masu zaman kansu - ta rubuta ga bishop a watan Yuli da damuwarta cewa bishop "zai yi ƙoƙari ya wuce farashin" ga majalisar limamin, duk da cewa majalisar limamin ba ta shiga cikin daukar masu zane da masu gina da bishop ya aika ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu ’yan cocin sun yi korafi kan rashin bayyana gaba a bangaren cocin.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Wani kifi ya ji rauni 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don lobster a California
rows.reference: Babban kifin teku ya raunata mai iyon neman lobster ɗan shekaru 13 a California

rows.output: Wani kifi ya kai hari ya raunana wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar yayin da yake nutsewa don kifi lobster a California a ranar farko ta kakar lobster, jami'ai sun ce.
rows.reference: Wani babban kifin teku ya kai hari da raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar a lokacin da yake iyon neman losbter a cikin California a ranar buɗe lokacin lobster, kamar yadda jami’ai suka ce.

rows.output: An kai harin da misalin karfe 7 na safe a kusa da bakin teku na Beacon a Encinitas.

rows.output: Chad Hammel ya gaya wa KSWB-TV a San Diego cewa ya kasance yana nutsewa tare da abokansa kusan rabin sa'a a safiyar Asabar lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kira don taimako, sai ya yi tafiya tare da wasu don taimakawa su ciro shi daga cikin ruwa.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel ya fada wa gidan talabijin na KSWB-TV a San Diego yana iyo ne tare da abokansa na kusan rabin sa’a a ranar Asabar da safe a lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kururuwa shi ke nan sai ya nufi wurin tare da wani gungun mutane don su jawo shi waje daga ruwan.

rows.output: Hammel ya ce da farko ya yi tunanin cewa kawai sha'awa ne na kama lobster ne, amma sai ya "gane cewa yana yi wa kansa ihu, 'Na yi rauni!'
rows.reference: Hammel ya ce da farko ya ɗauka wata annishuwa ce ta kama wani losbter, amma shi ke nan sai ya “gano cewa ihu yake yi, ‘An cije ni!

rows.output: Na samu ciwo!

rows.output: An yanke dukkan clavicle nasa," in ji Hammel da ya lura da shi da zarar ya isa yaron.

rows.output: "Na yi kuka ga kowa da kowa ya fita daga ruwa: 'Akwai wani kifi a cikin ruwan!'" Hammel ya kara.

rows.output: Kyaftin Larry Giles ya bayyana a wani taron manema labarai cewa an ga wani kifin shark a yankin kusan makonni uku kafin haka, amma an gano cewa ba wani nau'in kifin shark da ke da haɗari ba ne.

rows.output: Giles ya kara cewa wanda aka azabtar ya samu rauni mai tsanani a yankin kirjinsa.

rows.output: Jami'ai sun rufe shiga bakin teku daga Ponto Beach a Casablanca zuwa Swami's a Encinitas na tsawon sa'o'i 48 domin bincike da dalilan tsaro.

rows.output: Sainsbury's yana fafatawa da Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da hanyoyin kantin sayar da kayan kwalliya da ma'aikatan masu kwarewa.

rows.output: A matsayin wani bangare na wani babban ci gaba zuwa kasuwar kyawar UK ta £2.8bn, wanda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan kwalliya da kayan gida ke komawa baya, za a gwada manyan hanyoyin kyawar a cikin shaguna 11 a fadin kasar, kuma za a kai su wasu shaguna na shekara mai zuwa idan ya yi nasara.

rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin nan, wata akalar ruwan ta fara kankama a saman Tekun Pacific inda ta motsa gabas zuwa Bakin Teku na Yamma na Amurka. Kamar yadda Rosa ke tunkaran zirin Baja California a ranar Litinin a matsayin wani babban haɗari za ta fara tura laimar zafi zuwa yankin arewaci cikin kudu-maso-yamma na Amurka.

rows.output: Rosa za ta kawo har zuwa inci 10 na ruwa a wasu sassan Mexico a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Rosa za ta haifar da har kusan inci 10 na ruwan sama a sassan Mexico a ranar Litinin.

rows.output: Sannan, danshi na wurare masu zafi da ke mu'amala da guguwar da ke gabatowa za su haifar da ruwan sama mai yawa a duk faɗin kudu maso yammacin duniya a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan, laimar zafin idan ta haɗu tare da akalar ruwa da ke fuskantowa za ta ƙirƙiri wani ruwan sama da zai isa wurare masu yawa a cikin kudu-maso-yamma a kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.output: A cikin gida, milimita 25 zuwa 100 na ruwa zai haifar da ambaliyar ruwa mai haɗari, guguwar guguwa, da kuma yiwuwar ambaliya a cikin hamada.
rows.reference: A cikin gida, inci 1 zuwa 14 na ruwan sama zai haifar da mummunan ambaliya, kwararar burbushi da kuma yiwuwar zaizayar ƙasa a cikin hamadar.

rows.output: Zazzabin ruwa mai zafi sosai zai haifar da yawan ruwan sama da zai kai inci 2 zuwa 3 a kowace awa a wasu wurare, musamman a sassan kudu maso kudancin Nevada da Arizona.
rows.reference: Matsananciyar laimar zafi za ta iya haifar da kimomin ruwan sama da zai fuskanci incina 2 zuwa 3 a kowace sa’a a cikin wuraren, musamman a cikin sassa na kudancin Nevada da Arizona.

rows.output: Kamar inci 2 zuwa 4 na ruwa yana sa ran a wasu sassan Kudu maso Yamma, musamman a kan yawancin Arizona.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin inci 2 zuwa 4 na ruwan sama a sassan kudu-maso-yamma, musamman a mafi yawanci na Arizona.

rows.output: Hanyar ruwa mai sauri tana yiwuwa tare da yanayin da ke raguwa cikin sauri saboda yanayin ruwan damina na rarrabe.
rows.reference: Akwai yiwuwar samun ambaliya ruwa ba ƙaƙƙautawa saboda yanda lalacewar yanayi ke ci gaba da ta'azzara saboda irin yadda ruwan sama ke sauka a yanki mai zafi yake jifa-jifa.

rows.output: Zai zama mara kyau sosai a yi tafiya a cikin hamada da ƙafafu tare da hadarin ruwan damina na wurare masu zafi.
rows.reference: Mummunan shawara ne a fita zuwa cikin hamada da kafa ganin barazanar ruwan saman na wuri mai zafin.

rows.output: Ruwan sama mai nauyi na iya sa kananan koguna su zama koguna masu tashin hankali, kuma guguwar iska za ta kawo iska mai karfi a yankin da kumaura.
rows.reference: Ruwan sama mai yawan zai iya haifar da kwazazzabai su zama koguna masu gudu kuma cidar ruwa za ta haifar da iska mai ƙura da kaɗa ƙura.

rows.output: Tashin da ke gabatowa zai kawo ruwan sama mai yawa a wasu sassan gabar tekun Kudu California.
rows.reference: Akalar ruwan saman da ke fuskantowa za ta jawo ruwan sama mai yawa ta gida zuwa ga sassa na bakin teku na Kudancin California.

rows.output: Ruwan sama na sama da rabin inci na iya faruwa, wanda zai iya haifar da ƙananan guguwa da hanyoyin da ba su da kyau.
rows.reference: Akwai yiwuwar samun jimillar ruwan sama na sama da wani inci, wanda zai haifar da ɗan ƙaramin kwararar burbushi kuma hanyoyin mota su yi santsi.

rows.output: Wannan zai zama farkon ruwan sama a wannan yanki a lokacin damina.
rows.reference: Wannan zai zama ruwan sama na farko na lardin na lokacinsu na damuna.

rows.output: Wasu ruwan sama na ruwa na wurare masu zafi za su fara kusantar Arizona a karshen Lahadi da farkon Talata, kafin ruwan sama ya zama mafi yawan jama'a a karshen Talata da Laraba.
rows.reference: Wani ruwan sama jifa-jifa na wurin zafi zai fara fuskantowa Arizona a makare ranar Lahadi da farkon ranar Litinin, kafin ruwan saman zai zama ya bazu da yawa ranar Litinin a makare da Talata.

rows.output: Ruwan sama mai nauyi zai bazu zuwa Hudu Corners a ranar Talata kuma ya dade har zuwa Alhamis.
rows.reference: Ruwan sama mai yawa zai bazu a cikin Kusurwowi Huɗu a ranar Talata har ya kai cikin Laraba.

rows.output: Oktoba na iya ganin wasu manyan canje-canje na zafin jiki a Amurka yayin da Arctic ke sanyi, amma tropics suna da zafi sosai.
rows.reference: Watan Oktoba zai iya ganin wani tsananin yanayi mai juyawa a faɗin Amurka kamar yadda Arctic ke ƙara sanyi, amma kuma wurare masu zafin za su ci gaba da kasancewa da dumi.

rows.output: Wani lokaci hakan ke haifar da manyan canje-canje a zafin jiki a cikin ƙananananyoyi.
rows.reference: A wasu lokutan wannan zai kai ga canje-canje masu ban mamaki a cikin yanayi na wasu lokuta gajeru.

rows.output: Akwai babban misali na ban mamaki na bambance-bambancen yanayi ta hanyar tsakiyar Amurka a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Akwai wani babban misali na bambance-bambancen yanayi mai ban mamaki ta cikin tsakiyar Amurka a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Akwai kusanin digiri 20 na bambanci a yanayin zafi tsakanin Kansas City, Missouri, da Omaha, Nebraska, da kuma tsakanin St. Louis da Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Akwai kusan wani bambancin yanayi na digiri 20 tsakanin  Birnin Kansas, Missouri, da Omaha, Nebraska, da tsakanin  St. Louis da Des Moines, Iowa.

rows.output: A cikin kwanaki masu zuwa, zafi na rani da ya rage zai yi ƙoƙarin gina kansa da kuma fadada.
rows.reference: A ‘yan kwanaki masu zuwa, ɗumin lokacin zafi zai yi ƙoƙari ya ginu da sake faɗaɗa.

rows.output: Yawancin tsakiyar da gabashin Amurka na sa ran za su fara watan Oktoba da zafi tare da zafi a ko'ina a cikin 80s daga Kogin Kudu zuwa sassan Arewa maso Gabas.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin yawancin tsakiya da gabashin Amurka za ta ga wani ɗumi da zai fara zuwa Oktoba tare da bazuwar 80s daga Sararin Kudanci zuwa ga sassa na Arewa-maso-gabas.

rows.output: Birnin New York na iya kai 80 digiri a ranar Talata, wanda zai kasance kusan digiri 10 sama da matsakaicin.
rows.reference: Birnin New York zai iya kai wa digiri 80a ranar Talata, wanda aƙalla ya kai digiri 10 a sama matsakaici.

rows.output: Hasashen yanayi na dogon lokaci yana nuna yawan yiwuwar zafin yanayi sama da matsakaici ga gabashin Amurka a cikin rabin farko na Oktoba.
rows.reference: Hasashen yanayin namu mai tsawo yana nuna babban kintace yiwuwar matsakaicin yanayi na sama don gabashin Amurka a cikin farkon rabin Oktoba.

rows.output: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 sun kalli shari’ar Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli jin bahasi na Brett Kavanaugh

rows.output: Fiye da mutane miliyan ashirin da biyu sun kalli shaidar da ta yi a ranar Alhamis, wanda ya hada da alkalin kotun koli, Brett Kavanaugh, da kuma mace da ta zarge shi da cin zarafi, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwar talabijin shida.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli shaida mai riƙewa daga wanda aka tura sunan don kujerar Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh da matar da ke ƙararsa a kan cin zarafi na jima’i da ake cewa ya faru a cikin shekaru na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwar gidajen talabijin guda shida.

rows.output: A lokacin da ake ci gaba da takaddunawa a siyasance, masu watsa shirye-shirye sun dakatar da shirye-shiryen yau da kullum don wani canji na ƙarshe na ranar Juma'a: wani yarjejeniyar da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya tsara domin FBI ta gudanar da binciken na mako guda kan zarge-zargen.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin haka, rikicin siyasar ya ci gaba, tare da masu yada labarai suna katsse shirin da ake yi na kullum don wani sauyi da aka yi na ranar Jumu’a a makare: wata yarjejeniya da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya haifar don Hukumar FBI ta yi wani bincike na mako guda na tuhume-tuhumen.

rows.output: Ford ta gaya wa Majalisar Shari'a ta Majalisar Dattijai cewa tana da 100 cikin 100 na tabbacin cewa Kavanaugh ya yi yunkurin yi mata fyade da kuma yi ƙoƙarin cire mata kayan kanta a wani biki na makarantar sakandare.
rows.reference: Ford ya faɗa a Kwamitin Shari’a na Majalisar Dattijai cewa tana da tabbaci kashi 100 cewa Kavanaugh ta cakume ta yana cikin maye kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin cire mata tufafinta a wani biki na makarantar sakandare.

rows.output: Kavanaugh, a cikin shaidar da ta yi ta zuciya, ta ce ba ta faru ba.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, a cikin shaida mai ɓacin rai, ya ce yana tabbaci kashi 100 cewa abin bai faru ba.

rows.output: Yana yiwuwa cewa fiye da mutane miliyan 20.4 da Nielsen ya ba da rahoto a ranar Juma'a suka kallon shi.
rows.reference: Ba mamaki fiye da mutane miliyan 20.4 ne a rahoton Nielsen suka kalli abin.

rows.output: An yi la'akari da matsakaita masu kallo a CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel, da MSNBC.
rows.reference: Kamfanin ya lasafta matsakaicin yawan masu kallo ne ta CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel da MSNBC.

rows.output: An ba da rahoton cewa ba a samu bayanan da suka shafi sauran hanyoyin da suka nuna shi ba, ciki har da PBS, C-SPAN da Fox Business Network.
rows.reference: Ba a sami alƙaluma ba nan da nan ga sauran hanyoyin sadarwa da suka nuna abin, da suka haɗa da PBS, C-SPAN da Fox Business Network ɗin.

rows.output: kuma Nielsen yawanci yana da wasu matsala wajen auna mutanen da ke kallon ofisoshi.
rows.reference: Kuma Nielsen yawanci yana samun matsala ta auna mutane da suka kalla a cikin ofisoshinsu.

rows.output: Don sanya hakan a hangen nesa, wannan jama'a ta kai girma kamar wasan kusa da na karshe na kwallon kafa ko kuma lambar yabo ta Academy.
rows.reference: Don a fito da abin a fili, wancan shi ne kamar girman yawan masu kallo a wasan ƙwallo na wa ka ci ka tashiko ba da Kyaututtukan Academy.

rows.output: Fox News Channel, wanda masu gabatar da ra'ayin sa suka goyi bayan amincewa da Kavanaugh, ya jagoranci duk tashoshin da 5.69 miliyan masu kallo a lokacin sauraren dukan rana, in ji Nielsen.
rows.reference: Tashar Fox News, wadda masu gabatar da ra’ayi sun matukar goyi bayan ɗaukan na Kavanaugh, inda ya jagoranci dukkan hanyoyin sadarwa da ke da matsakaicin masu kallo miliyan 5.69 a lokacin jin bahasin da duk ranar, inji Nielsen.

rows.output: ABC ta kasance ta biyu da masu kallo miliyan 3.26.
rows.reference: ABC ita ce ta biyu mai masu kallo miliyan 3.26.

rows.output: An ba da rahoton cewa CBS ta samu mutane miliyan 3.1, NBC ta samu mutane miliyan 2.94, MSNBC ta samu mutane miliyan 2.89, kuma CNN ta samu mutane miliyan 2.52, in ji Nielsen.
rows.reference: CBS tana da miliyan 3.1, NBC miliyan 2.94, MSNBC miliyan 2.89 da CNN mai miliyan 2.52, inji Nielsen.

rows.output: An ci gaba da sha'awa bayan sauraron.
rows.reference: Sha’awa ta kasance ta yi sama bayan sauraron.

rows.output: Flake ita ce babban mutum a cikin wasan kwaikwayo na Juma'a.
rows.reference: Flake shi ne sananne a tsakiya a cikin diramar Juma’ar.

rows.output: Bayan daakinakin Republican mai ra'ayi na tsakiya ya fitar da wata sanarwa cewa zai yi zanga-zanga ga Kavanaugh, an kama shi da kyamarorin CNN da CBS a safiyar Juma'a yana fuskantar masu zanga-zanga da ke yi masa ihu yayin da yake kokarin shiga wani zauren Majalisar Shari'a.
rows.reference: Bayan ofishin ‘yan Republican mai matsakaicin ra’ayi ya fitar da wata jawabi cewa zai zaɓi Kavanaugh, kyamarorin CNN da CBS sun nuna shi a ranar Jumu’a yana ihu a masu zanga-zanga a lokacin da yake ƙoƙarin hawa na’urar ɗaukan mutane zuwa saman bene zuwa ga wurin taron Kwamiti a kan Shari’a.

rows.output: Ya tsaya da ido a kasa na tsawon mintuna da dama yayin da yake fuskantar sukar, an watsa shiaihai a CNN.
rows.reference: Ya tsaya da idanuwa a ƙasa na tsawon mintina masu yawa a yayin da ake yi masa ihu, ana nunawa a talabijin na CNN.

rows.output: "Ina tsaye a nan a gaban ku," wata mace ta ce.
rows.reference: “Ina tsaye a nan a gabanka,” inji wata mata.

rows.output: "Kuna ganin yana magana da gaskiya ga ƙasar?
rows.reference: “Kana jin yana faɗan gaskiya ne ga ƙasar?

rows.output: An gaya masa, "kana da iko lokacin da da yawa mata ba su da iko."
rows.reference: An gaya masa, “kana da dukkan ƙarfi a lokacin da mata da yawa ba su da ƙarfi.””

rows.output: Flake ya ce ofishinsa ya fitar da wata sanarwa, ya ce kafin lif ya rufe, zai kara magana a zaman majalisar kwamitin.
rows.reference: Flake ya ce ofishinsa ya fitar wani bayani kuma ya ce, kafin na’urar ɗaukan mutanen ta rufe, cewa yana da abu mai yawa da zai faɗa a wurin bahasin kwamitin.

rows.output: An yi wa dukkan hanyoyin sadarwa da watsa shirye-shirye, sa'o'i masu rai daga baya, lokacin da kwamitin shari'a zai yi zaben ci gaba da zaben Kavanaugh na nadin zuwa majalisar dattijai domin yin zabe.
rows.reference: Hanyoyin sadarwa na kebul da masu watsawa dukka suna yaɗa abin lokacin da ake yi sa’o’i daga baya, a lokacin da Kwamitin Shari’ar ke kaɗa kuri’a don tura ba da sunan Kavanaugh zuwa ga cikekkiyar Majalisar Dattawan don wani kaɗa kuri’ar.

rows.output: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi hakan ne kawai idan an fahimtar cewa FBI za ta bincika zargin da ake yi wa wanda aka zaba na mako mai zuwa, wanda 'yan Democrat na minority suka yi kira.
rows.reference: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi kawai hakan ne tare da fahimtar cewa hukumar bincike ta FBI za ta duba kagen a kan wanda aka ba da sunan nasa a mako mai zuwa, wanda ‘yan tsiraru jam’iyyar Democrat suke ta fata.

rows.output: An yi wa Flake imani, a wani bangare, ta hanyar tattaunawa da abokinsa, Sanatan Dimokuradiyya Chris Coons.
rows.reference: Flake ya gamsu ɗan kaɗa da hirarraki tare da abokinsa, Sanatan jam’iyyar Democrat Chris Coons.

rows.output: Bayan tattaunawa da Coons da kuma wasu Sanatoci da dama bayan haka, Flake ya yanke shawarar sa.
rows.reference: Bayan wata hira tare da Coons da sanatoci masu yawa daga baya, Flake ya yanke hukuncinsa.

rows.output: Ndị AM Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere nchegbu n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs n'ihe gbasara atụmatụ mgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ malitere n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha nke ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe usoro ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpata ihe ọchị.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu onye Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-ada ụda na Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara onye na-adịghị mma n'obi ma pwp pụtara ihe na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ n'ozuzu ya "adịghị mma" ma tụọ aro ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na otu ya "na-eche echiche" banyere mgbanwe aha, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere okwu okwu site na MWP ruo Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'okwu a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka mkpụrụedemede Yorkshire English u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Ụlọ, nke na-ede iwu ugbu a iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "mkpebi ikpeazụ maka ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Assembly bụ, n'ezie, ihe ga-adabere na ndị otu onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Welsh Act 2017 nyere Ụlọ ọrụ Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, Ụlọ Ọrụ ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nyocha ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọna ahụ chọrọ ndị otu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọpụta MWP nwetara nkwado kacha ukwuu n'oge nyocha ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AMs na-ekwu na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana ọsọsọ iru nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ isi ike maka onye isi oche, Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eziga ọrụ iwu na mgbanwe n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe ahụ ga-agụnyekwa mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otú ụlọ omebe iwu si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu gbasara ịhapụ ndị otu na nhazi usoro kọmiti.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enweta votu ikpeazụ na ajụjụ nke ihe ha kwesịrị ịkpọ mgbe ha na-eme iwu.
rows.reference: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-aga n'ihu na ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha obodo.
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha

rows.output: Ndị na-eme ntuli aka ga-eme ntuli aka na Sọnde ma ọ bụrụ na ha gabanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia."
